metadata.description: Claude Code commands for Exocortex workspaces

plugins.name: exo
plugins.description: Exocortex workspace commands: /exo:project (new, load, update, board, land), /exo:content (status, commit, land), /exo:roadmap (project structure: synthesize, revise, diff), /exo:todo (inbox/todos.md: add, list, set, done), /exo:next (one project's open items in waves), /exo:onboard (morning digest), /exo:eod (end of day), /exo:discuss (discussion partner), /exo:decision-ui (offline batch decisions) and /exo:doc-formatter (format content into workspace documents); a SessionStart hook warns when the workspace's persona plugin is missing.
